name: Themeslab Remove Add to Cart, Product Enquiry for WooCommerce
author: WP Themes Lab

sections.description:
Themeslab Remove Add to Cart & Product Enquiry for WooCommerce gives store owners full control over product purchase availability and customer inquiry options.

Many WooCommerce stores sell specialized goods, wholesale items, custom-manufactured products, or high-value inventory that requires direct customer consultation rather than instant online checkout. Standard WooCommerce setups force every product through a fixed shopping cart flow, which can cause friction for businesses that operate on custom quotes or catalog views.

This plugin solves that problem by allowing you to selectively disable the Add to Cart button and replace or complement it with a responsive Contact Form 7 product enquiry form. You can control visibility globally or target specific product types, product categories, or individual product IDs.

Key Features

  • Flexible Add to Cart Removal: Disable purchase functionality across your entire store, or target specific product types (Simple, Variable, Grouped, External/Affiliate), product categories, or individual product IDs.
  • Targeted Inclusions & Exclusions: Exclude specific products from cart removal rules, keeping instant purchase active on standard products while converting select items into inquiry-only products.
  • Contact Form 7 Integration: Select any active Contact Form 7 form from your store to serve as your product enquiry form.
  • Popup and Inline Display Modes:
    • Popup Form: Display a customizable enquiry trigger button that opens a responsive modal form.
    • Inline Form: Embed the inquiry form directly into the product page layout.
  • Multiple Display Placement Options:
    • Popup Button Locations: Next to purchase area, after purchase area, or after short description.
    • Inline Locations: At purchase area, below purchase area, after short description, before product tabs, or inside a dedicated product tab.
  • Automatic Cart Removal Fallbacks: If cart removal is active on a product and an inquiry button or form is set to render at the purchase area, the plugin automatically falls back to an optimal page position so your inquiry options always remain visible.
  • Product Context Email Tags for CF7: Pass exact product information directly into Contact Form 7 email templates without editing saved form markup or database entries.
  • Real-time Variable Product Tracking: Automatically captures selected variation IDs, variation SKUs, and human-readable variation attributes when customers select options on variable products.
  • Server-Side Security & Data Validation: Validates submitted product IDs directly against published database records before sending emails to prevent browser DOM tampering.
  • Built-in Admin Style Controls: Customize form titles, subtitles, font sizes, text colors, button background/hover states, input borders, and submit button styles straight from the admin dashboard.
  • HPOS Compatible: Built following modern WooCommerce standards with official High-Performance Order Storage support.

Contact Form 7 Mail Tags

When product email tags are enabled in the plugin settings, you can use the following tags in your Contact Form 7 → Mail settings (Subject or Message Body):

  • [product_name] — Full title of the product being enquired about.
  • [product_url] — Direct permalink URL to the product page.
  • [product_id] — Database ID of the parent product.
  • [product_sku] — SKU of the parent product (blank if none set).
  • [variation_id] — ID of the selected variation (for variable products).
  • [variation_sku] — SKU of the selected variation (for variable products).
  • [variation_details] — Formatted attribute details of the selected variation (e.g., Color: Blue, Size: Large).

Common Use Cases

  • Catalog Mode Stores: Turn WooCommerce into an online catalog where prices or inquiry options display without direct checkout.
  • Custom Quotes & Wholesale: Allow B2B buyers or wholesale clients to request custom pricing quotes on specific products or categories.
  • Out of Stock or Pre-order Items: Replace purchase buttons with inquiry forms for out-of-stock, incoming, or high-demand products.
  • Services & Made-to-Order Products: Collect detailed project requirements before accepting orders on customized goods.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the themeslab-remove-cart-and-product-enquiry directory to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin directly through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Ensure WooCommerce is active (and Contact Form 7 if using product enquiry forms).
  4. Navigate to WooCommerce → Remove Cart & Enquiry in your WordPress dashboard to configure your settings.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require Contact Form 7?

The Add to Cart removal features work independently of Contact Form 7. Contact Form 7 is only required if you enable the Product Enquiry form feature.

Can I remove the Add to Cart button for specific categories only?

Yes. You can enable category filtering in the settings and select the specific categories where you want to disable cart buttons.

How do variable products work with enquiry forms?

When a customer selects variation attributes on a variable product page, the plugin captures the selected variation ID, SKU, and chosen attributes in real-time and passes them through the [variation_id], [variation_sku], and [variation_details] mail tags in your Contact Form 7 emails.

Will the enquiry form show if I remove the Add to Cart button?

Yes. The plugin includes automatic fallbacks so that if a form or button is set to display in the purchase area, it remains visible even when the standard WooCommerce cart form is disabled.
sections.changelog:
1.0.0

  • Initial release. Features include conditional Add to Cart removal, Contact Form 7 product enquiry forms, popup/inline modes, real-time variation tracking, server-side data verification, and HPOS compatibility.
